## This workflow 
provides a convenient and automated way to stay on top of your daily meetings and improve your personal productivity.

### Create a Telegram bot in @botfather
Uses your Telegram user ID to send the list of meetings as a message to Telegram.

## setup:
###    - Google Calendar connected to n8n
###    - A Telegram bot created and connected to n8n
###    - Your Telegram user ID specified
